## Requirements

1. OTLP/HTTP (JSON) export of the lowered convention spans through the
   mediator to a configured loopback collector — a new sink wire shape
   beside the landed `Json::Arr(batch.rows)` batch POST, carried on the
   same `net_egress` request + mediation contract.
2. `measurement.export.delivered` rows only for collector-acknowledged
   deliveries (a 2xx wire answer); a forwarded-but-not-acknowledged
   delivery mints no row. Refused deliveries stay refused rows
   (`PollOutcome::Refused` — `security.egress.*` durable, no delivered
   row).
3. Live leg `otel-live` in `scripts/live-verify.sh` — start the
   HUMAN-H6-provisioned Jaeger 2.22.0 collector, run a short local run,
   export, query the collector for the run's trace id; evidence
   committed under `docs/build/reports/live/`. Collector absent →
   `skipped(<reason>)` recorded, never fabricated.
4. ADR-0346 trigger (a) fired-answered note in `docs/build/reports/`;
   BL-31 row progress append.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Hermetic exporter tests against a loopback OTLP receiver fixture
      (ack / reject / mediator-refused) — layer: fixture-verified.
- [ ] `otel-live` evidence committed: the collector returns the run's
      spans — layer: live-executed.
- [ ] Universal phase-gate AC — verification green; every new behaviour
      has a test that fails if removed; requirement ids stamped
      (`BL-31`, `R-2.9.1`, ADR-0346); unverifiable legs → DEFERRALS row;
      ADRs for deviations/owned decisions; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER
      advance; operating clauses met.

## Plan

- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/otlp.rs` (new): the OTLP/HTTP (JSON) wire
  lowering — `trace_service_request(spans_with_ts, service_name)` maps
  the convention-lowered spans (`genai::lower_run_refs` output —
  `{name, seq, span_id, duration_ms?, attributes{hh.run_id,
  hh.event_id, …}}`) onto an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest` document:
  `traceId = propagation::trace_id(hh.run_id)` (the ADR-0042/OQ-115
  provisional derivation — trigger (b) untouched), `spanId =
  propagation::span_id(hh.event_id)`, `startTimeUnixNano`/`endTimeUnixNano`
  anchored at the event's durable `ts` + measured `duration_ms`,
  convention attributes lowered to OTLP `KeyValue{key,value:AnyValue}`
  (`hh.*` lift members ride as attributes — the read-back proves both
  delivery and ledger coordinates). A span missing `hh.*` coords is a
  named loss, never a fabricated identity.
- `hh-telemetry/src/export.rs`: `sampled_keep` → `pub` (the OTLP fold
  applies the same deterministic sampling rule — CC1).
- `hh-embed/src/subscriber.rs`: `SinkDestination` gains `wire: SinkWire`
  (`BatchJson` default | `OtlpTraces { service_name }`); the OTLP poll
  folds `genai::lower_run_refs` over the page (sampling applied), POSTs
  the trace request through the same `net_egress` handle, and appends
  `measurement.export.delivered` only on a 2xx wire answer —
  non-acknowledgement answers `PollOutcome::NotAcknowledged` (the
  decided{allow} + charge rows stand; no delivered row). Empty-span
  pages with model.* loss still export (the loss rides
  `loss_report_ref`); pages with no projected rows answer `Quiet` and
  advance the watermark.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7c.rs`: hermetic battery over a loopback
  OTLP receiver fixture — ack (200 → Delivered + valid OTLP body +
  trace_id/span_id derivations + `hh.*` attrs + delivered row), reject
  (500 → NotAcknowledged + zero delivered rows), mediator-refused
  (unlisted sink → Refused + zero delivered rows).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7c_live.rs`: ignored cell — real local
  `GatewayModel::one_shot` fills the run's `model.call.completed` with
  real usage/served_model, minted durable run, subscriber exports to
  `HH_OTEL_COLLECTOR`, read-back `GET {HH_OTEL_QUERY}/api/traces/<tid>`
  asserts the collector returned the run's spans; `OTEL_*` markers.
- `scripts/live-verify.sh`: `otel-live` leg — docker lifecycle for
  `jaegertracing/jaeger:2.22.0` (`127.0.0.1:4318` OTLP/HTTP,
  `127.0.0.1:16686` query), honest `skipped(collector-absent)` /
  `skipped(collector-unhealthy)` paths, USD 0.
- Docs: `docs/build/reports/2026-10-22-adr-0346-trigger.md`, BL-31
  progress append, run ledger, pr/R4.7c.md, BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER.
